implementation_contract.decision_function: A single pure guard evaluates capability, identity requirement, allowed caller IDs, command risk class, and required adapter guarantees before execution.

prohibitions: Do not hard-code developer or administrator IDs.
Do not merge auction administrator policy with ROM administrator or DEV policy.
Do not invent audit rows or idempotency guarantees absent from V1.
Do not register Telegram handlers, start main.py, open production SQLite, read .env, or wire production persistence.
Do not execute any DEV or administrator operation during implementation tests.

resolutions.implementation_rule: Authorization input = capability_enabled plus operation policy. Identity is required only where the authoritative V1 operation owner requires it; identity values are injected by configuration and never embedded.
resolutions.resolution: Preserve V1 separation. DEV_MODE is a capability gate, not proof of caller identity. Commands that V1 intentionally exposes only through DEV handler registration remain DEV-capability operations; administrative production operations retain their authoritative allowlist guard. V2 must represent both inputs explicitly and must not invent developer IDs.

Python last-definition semantics select the final top-level register_dev_handlers definition in handlers/dev.py. main.py invokes that exported name. Earlier same-name definitions are shadow evidence, not parallel runtime owners.

V2 must register only explicitly declared command specifications. Each specification requires one of READ_ONLY, CONTROLLED_MUTATION, DESTRUCTIVE_RESET, or ADMIN_PRODUCTION. db_modules/dev_compat.py helpers cannot authorize or self-register commands. Exact Telegram command names remain transport metadata and are not implemented in the API-ready domain stage.

Preserve operation-specific V1 guarantees. ADMIN_PRODUCTION operations that already have durable audit/idempotency must require those capabilities. DEV operations without proven V1 durable audit must not receive an invented ledger; their API contract exposes audit_required and idempotency_required flags for fail-closed adapter validation.
Auction administrator authorization remains a separate authoritative policy. It must not be merged into ROM_ADMIN_USER_IDS or the DEV capability gate by Stage 21.15.1 implementation.
